description: The caption of a color rule as a saved color table or a saved Session is read (PD-OI-042 scenario revision 2, accepted residual risk). Builds between first-parent `main` fe6861f0 and the naming rule rewrote one caption written with several colors to `caption [fill]`, the fill being the rule's color as lower-case #rrggbb (a color name or #rgb resolved) or `none`, and saved the rewritten caption in the Session and in the downloaded color-table TSV. A caption that ends in ` [fill]` of its own rule's color is read without it, once; any other caption is read as written, also one that would be left blank. Python's answer is gbdraw/legend/table.py::saved_rule_caption (tests/test_specific_color_captions.py); the Web app's is services/specific-color-rules.js::savedRuleCaption (tests/web/specific-color-actions.test.mjs). `rules` pins the reading of a saved Session's rules, with the type colors of its drawing (`type_colors`, by type and `default`): the caption as above, then a `hash` rule named like its type's "other" Legend row in that type's color (the rule Reset fill color wrote before it wrote `palette`, Web of first-parent `main` since a6aa233f3) is read as `palette` without a caption (`read`); any other rule as written. Python's answer is gbdraw/legend/table.py::saved_rule_captions (gbdraw/session.py replays a Session so); the Web app's is services/specific-color-rules.js::savedSpecificRules (services/config.js Load). A color table file is read without type colors: as written.
